messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] High-severity: unusual auth token reuse observed from multiple IPs across eu-west and us-west. Alert I-216800. Suspected debug-log egress; some S3 objects in staging contain Authorization headers. Triage channel opened.
jenna (oncall): seeing it. paging mike and alisa. are we sure these are production tokens or staging? :thinking_face:
mike (sre): initial look — tokens originate from our proxy pool, but target bucket is `redwood-staging-logs`. headers with `Authorization: Bearer ...` found in raw debug dumps. volume small but repeated requests over last 2 hrs.
alisa (sec): treat as potential exposure until we confirm. start containment: block source IPs, stop token minting for affected service, and rotate service token seeds. i'll coordinate key rotation.
dinesh (eng-runtime): flagged runbook 'auth-exposure' — recommending immediate `deny` route on edge for token issuance endpoints and enable fallback to short-lived guest tokens. putting quick patch to disallow `debug=true` param at proxy.
jenna (oncall): actionable checklist please. i'll start customer-impact assessment and call tree.
incident-bot: runbook link: <https://wiki.internal/incidents/auth-exposure|Auth Exposure Runbook> — step 1: identify token families, step 2: rotate service keys, step 3: revoke active sessions.
sasha (infra): blocking CIDR `54.93.0.0/16` and `13.35.0.0/16` on WAF for now. adding temporary denylist by geolocation. monitoring.
mike (sre): query to list tokens in issue window:
```
SELECT token_id, svc, issued_at FROM auth.tokens WHERE issued_at > '2026-03-14T20:00:00Z' AND src_ip IN (SELECT ip FROM suspicious_ips);
```
we'll expire tokens in batches.
alisa (sec): plan: (1) rotate service API key for `logging-agent` and `staging-ingest` (2) revoke tokens issued by those services (3) rotate any long-lived keys in KMS. will need support from infra for HSM rollover.
dinesh (eng-runtime): i can push endpoint change to reject `debug=*` and drop Authorization header logging in the runtime before 1m rollout. patch is small:
```
if request.query.get('debug'):
  request.headers.remove('Authorization')
```
will roll canary to eu-west first.
ravi (cust-success): tagging impacted accounts I see two customers with increased 401s earlier — reaching out. need language for emails and whether we should proactively rotate customer tokens (likely not unless confirmed). what do we tell them?
alisa (sec): don't tell customers about internal debug logs until we confirm scope. notify CISO and legal. craft holding statement: "We detected anomalous authentication activity and are investigating; we have containment measures in place." we'll escalate if evidence of exfiltration to external services.
jenna (oncall): handoff plan: i'm on for next 30m then handing to mike for incident lead. mike can you take lead for mitigation and keep me in loop? i'll update exec-summary at :30.
mike (sre): taking lead. i'll coordinate rotations and revokes. jenna keep customer comms and exec updates.
incident-bot: paging policy: @mike (sre) has been assigned incident leader. On-call rotation updated.
sasha (infra): rotating `staging-ingest` keys now. will post KMS audit id when done.
mike (sre): executing token expiry job in 5m for tokens from `logging-agent` and `staging-ingest`. command:
```
./tools/authctl expire --service logging-agent --since "2026-03-14T20:00:00Z"
```
will monitor error rate and rollout.
jenna (oncall): customer-impact note: minimal 401s observed for 0.3% of active sessions, likely staging/test apps; no production billing traffic hit. i'll compile list of affected customer org ids and hand to ravi.
ravi (cust-success): got it. prepping customer note template. will wait for sec greenlight.
alisa (sec): observed one S3 object showing `Authorization:` with Bearer token and truncated user email. object last-modified ~ 2026-03-14T21:12Z. investigating access logs for GETs to that object. possible internal dev upload — don't rule out developer mistake.
dinesh (eng-runtime): adding config change to drop headers to logs at ingest layer right now. pushing patch across canary -> all within 12m.
sasha (infra): KMS rotation complete for `staging-ingest` key. audit id `KMS-AUD-2168-01`.
mike (sre): token expire job started. first batch expired 4.2k tokens. CPU spike on auth workers but within headroom. watching for downstream 401 surge.
jenna (oncall): handoff: mike, you're lead. i'll update exec at :30 and then pass command to alisa for postmortem once stabilized. tagging @ravi for customer follow-up.
alisa (sec): next steps: full S3 bucket scan for leaked headers, identify all objects with `Authorization:` pattern, and determine if any external IP accessed them. also check CI pipelines that may have pushed debug artifacts.
incident-bot: Note: create postmortem ticket `INC-216800` and assign to incident-lead.
mike (sre): creating ticket and linking runbook. linking to this thread in the ticket.
jenna (oncall): quick note for runbook: add step to block dev uploads of raw headers and enforce scrubbing in the SDK.
dinesh (eng-runtime): will patch SDK to scrub Authorization from logs and cut a minor release. target within 48h but hotfix for staging in 2h.
alisa (sec): legal loop initiated. if we see external GETs to leaked objects, we escalate to full security incident response.
ravi (cust-success): prepared holding message. ready to send to affected customers once sec approves.
mike (sre): monitoring shows blocked IPs falling off. token-related 401s peaked and trending down after expiry. will keep watch 1h post-rotation.
jenna (oncall): thanks team. mike you own the incident now. alisa you'll lead the investigation. i'll join the postmortem and customer update. handing off.
mike (sre): acknowledged. continuing operations. will post updates every 15m or on significant change.
incident-bot: Incident thread closed to new pings per oncall request; updates will be appended to ticket `INC-216800`. React with :white_check_mark: to acknowledge.
